card.name: Inside brand names of new drugs
card.fires_on: Partway through capitalized brand names, such as SKYTROFA, JUVMO, BEVESPI AEROSPHERE and Vantive, in prescribing-information text. It also fires on a few small words right next to a brand name.

modes.label: Inside brand name
modes.description: Middle pieces of an uppercase or unusual brand name, mostly right after the start of the name.

modes.label: Company name start
modes.description: The first piece of a company name in the adverse-reaction reporting line.

card.writes: It favors odd, rare name pieces and suppresses common word starts like co, ex and tech, so the name continues as a brand rather than an ordinary word.
card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual brand name so the model keeps spelling out the name.
